plan: [This is a second-price sealed-bid with three bidders: your payment equals the highest other bid. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy. With private value $30, bidding $30 maximizes expected profit: you win whenever the highest other bid < $30 and pay that bid, yielding positive surplus, and you avoid overpaying. Ties resolved randomly; 0.1 increments are sufficient. No prior history alters this strategy for the one-round game.]

[This is a second-price (Vickrey-style) auction with independent private values; bidding your true value is a weakly dominant strategy. With value $28 and 0.1 increments, bid truthfully to maximize expected surplus: you win whenever the highest competitor bid is below 28 and pay that highest other bid, ensuring optimal long-run profit.]

[This is a sealed-bid second-price auction (winner pays the highest other bid).
